verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents drop-in OpenAI compatibility, says every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, and offers a self-hosted proxy that issues virtual keys. A maintainer confirmed the proxy handles streaming and function-calling the same way as the openai-python SDK. missing for 10: explicit documentation that only the base_url and api_key need to change in existing OpenAI SDK code, coverage of OpenAI endpoints beyond chat completions, independent hands-on confirmation of a zero-code-change migration.
